$comment: Derived directly from the real React/Vite source in src/ (8 mounted routes in src/router.js) and from CLONE_SPEC.md / ASSET_MANIFEST.md, the same evidence base used to build design-repo/ alongside this file. Categories and section ids are this project's own vocabulary, not reused from another project.

meta.source: granola-clone — a pixel-fidelity clone of a real meeting-notes SaaS product, built React + Vite + Tailwind v3
meta.mirror: Homepage measured live via Playwright (see CLONE_SPEC.md); other 7 routes built from src/ and a live-pages/ HTML capture
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, cross-checked against design-repo/ (built the same session from the same source evidence)

categories.SHELL: Chrome present on every route: fixed navigation and the site footer (plus its overscroll reveal panel).
categories.HERO: The page-opening block for a given route: headline, primary CTA, and the route's signature visual/demo.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, testimonials, quotes, tweet walls.
categories.CONVERSION: Dedicated download/signup/sales CTA blocks, distinct from the CTA embedded in a hero.
categories.PRICING: Plan tiers, plan comparison, and pricing-page-specific FAQ/resources.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive unique body content of a route: blog list, article prose, careers listings, a contact form.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation: logo, Features dropdown, Enterprise/Pricing/Blog/Careers links, Talk to sales, Download button. Background/shadow transitions on scroll.

shell.footer.description: Site-wide link directory (Features/Product/Company/Resources columns), social icons, copyright line with a hover-swap 'Made with love in Shoreditch' easter egg, and the overscroll footer-reveal image panel.

conversion.footer-cta.description: A 3-block promo banner (bg-oats-green-300) driving a final download/signup conversion, placed just above the footer.
conversion.footer-cta.scope: Present on 6 routes: every route except Home (uses conversion.pricing-cta instead) and Enterprise (routes to sales, not self-serve), per the cta:true/false flag in src/App.jsx's PAGES map.

hero.marketing.description: The homepage hero: 'New' badge linking to the Apple Watch post, H1 'The AI notepad for back-to-back meetings', subcopy, accent download CTA, platform availability line, and a sticky app-window demo with GSAP-looped typing/enhance animation plus scroll-driven floating images and video-call thumbs.

social-proof.logo-wall.description: 'For the doers' headline sliding under a dark block containing a 12-logo grid of real customer companies (PostHog, Intercom, Figma, Brex, Ramp, Replit, Lovable, Cursor, Bumble, Asana, Vanta, Linear).

content.statement.description: A single-line brand statement bridging the logo wall and the how-it-works section.
content.statement.scope: Home only (1 route), rendered inline within Hero.jsx's sibling flow.

explainer.how-it-works.description: Three-stage scroll-synced walkthrough (before/during/after the meeting) with sticky tabs and per-step app-window/brief-card/action-card mockups; separate desktop (sticky tabs) and mobile (stacked) implementations.

product.chat-demo.description: 'Granola Chat' section with a self-typing, prompt-cycling demo card (4 category/prompt pairs) proving contextual memory.

social-proof.testimonials.description: Horizontally drag-scrollable card wall of 5 named, high-profile customer quotes (Linear/Vercel/a16z/Menlo Ventures CEOs and partners) with hover-tinted portrait tiles.

feature-grid.marketing.description: 5-item feature list (humans not bots, works with all meeting apps, private by default, made for in-person, syncs with calendar), each with a header/body pair and supporting image tile(s).

integration.connector-strip.description: MCP connector positioning: kicker, headline, body copy, and an auto-scrolling strip of 11 AI-tool integration logos with cosine-falloff scaling.

conversion.pricing-cta.description: Final homepage conversion card over a background image, with dual CTAs (download vs. view pricing).
conversion.pricing-cta.scope: Home only (1 route) — the route-specific substitute for conversion.footer-cta.

hero.chat-page.description: Chat page hero: headline/subheadline, a self-typing prompt demo in a 3D-tilted floating card, and animated wave-bar tiles.

feature-grid.chat-scenarios.description: 3 concrete chat-usage scenario cards (during a meeting, in a folder, across meetings) making the 'ask anything' promise tangible.

hero.enterprise.description: Enterprise hero: kicker, headline, body, 'Talk to sales' CTA, and a hero collage image — routes to sales rather than self-serve download.

trust.security-compliance.description: Trust strip plus an 8-item FAQ accordion addressing SOC2/SSO/data-training objections, reusing the Pricing page's FaqAccordion component directly.

pricing.plan-tiers.description: Headline/subheadline and the plan-tier grid (Basic plus paid tiers) with per-plan CTAs — the pricing page's primary conversion surface.

social-proof.single-quote.description: A single large-format customer endorsement (Pedro Franceschi, Brex) with a case-study link, between the plan tiers and the comparison table.

pricing.compare-table.description: Sticky-header feature-comparison table across all plan tiers.

faq.things-worth-noting.description: 8-item FAQ accordion on pricing/data/compliance objections, sharing the FaqAccordion component with trust.security-compliance.

content.resource-links.description: 3-card grid surfacing secondary trust/education content (security, transparency, help docs).

social-proof.tweet-wall.description: Masonry wall of 6 embedded tweet-style posts, broader/higher-volume social proof than the curated testimonials card wall.

social-proof.logo-marquee.description: Continuously CSS-marquee-scrolling customer logo strip, distinct from the static logo-wall grid on Home.

content.blog-list.description: A filterable index of blog/press posts (All/Blog/Press chip filter) — the sole content of the Blog route.

content.article-body.description: Full long-form prose body of a single blog article, with author byline, date, and share popover — the sole content of the BlogAppleWatch route.

careers.jobs-page.description: The full careers page as one continuous multi-zone section: hero statement, open-role listings grouped by category, and team stats/photos.

form.contact-sales.description: Headline plus an embedded real third-party Tally lead-capture form — the sole content of the Contact Sales route, and the one deliberate exception to the router's no-outbound-links constraint.
